Native-safe replacement for the shared web <Select> (no DOM <select> on native): an inline IntervalSelect — a Pressable trigger (current label + '\u25BE' caret) opening a transparent fade <Modal> popover whose options are accessible Pressable rows (accessibilityRole menu/menuitem, accessibilityState.selected), backed by a tap-to-close backdrop + onRequestClose. This is the same popover idiom as the already-ported Combobox / DataTableColumnsMenu and keeps all three call sites (master / category set-all / per-signal) on one reusable control.

Verified NO DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, clsx, or old web ui components are imported — only react-native primitives (Modal/Pressable/ScrollView/TextInput/View) plus the existing shared native AppText, theme tokens (colors/shadows/spacing), and the sibling ported Checkbox. State names (signals/search/masterInterval/expandedCats), the API/data shape (onSubmit {name,interval}[]), interval values, preset logic, and i18n-free English copy are preserved verbatim. A focused parity test (__tests__/SignalConfigModalParity.test.tsx) renders the open modal, asserts categories/signals/initialSelected, exercises Select All + Subscribe, and confirms onSubmit/onClose. Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
